messages:
Marta (PM): Morning — kickoff for the northstar portfolio scrub. Need to lock Q3/Q4 inference OKRs. Main tensions: chat/completions latency & throughput, embeddings SLOs for search pilots, rerank accuracy vs cost. Can folks share hard blockers and non-negotiables?

Ajay (Eng): Latency targets: we can promise 75ms p95 for short chat completions only if we accept smaller batch sizes and more capacity; otherwise p95 moves to ~150ms. Need to decide SLO envelope.

Sophia (SRE): If we push 75ms p95 universally, infra cost jumps ~35%. Also risk of higher preemptions in some cloud regions. Suggest tiered SLO: premium 75ms, standard 150ms, best-effort low-cost.

Lia (CS): Top 2 enterprise customers asked for embeddings consistency across regions + 30-day retention + KMS. Those are deal breakers for two pilots.

Drew (Applied ML): Rerank: accuracy gains from larger-context models are small vs 2x compute. Prefer investing in better evals and fast fallbacks to quantized variants.

Marta (PM): @Ajay can you quantify cost delta for the tiered SLO? Also need launch criteria: (a) telemetry for per-route latency, (b) canary with real customers, (c) automated fallback to cheaper model.

Ajay (Eng): I'll drop numbers by tomorrow. Rough: premium 75ms p95 doubles GPU commit, standard 150ms is baseline. Canary: need feature-flag + traffic split + auto-fallback. I'll add rollout checklist to the Console epic.

Sophia (SRE): On observability: need token-level tracing + route heatmap before canary. WIP PR: infra/telemetry-334. Also add 'kill-switch' to re-route to hosted fallback.

Lia (CS): Can we commit to embeddings SLA for pilot customers (99.9% availability) if they run on Dedicated? They won't accept hosted for now.

Marta (PM): Decision proposal: tiered latency SLO; prioritize embeddings SLA on Dedicated + hosted best-effort embeddings; rerank via eval-first approach; rollout criteria = (a) telemetry merged, (b) canary with 3 pilot customers, (c) documented rollback plan. Thoughts?

Ajay (Eng): SGTM. One ask: add a perf budget card per slice so PMs see cost impact in Console. I'll add to Optimize epic.

Drew (Applied ML): Agree. Also let's define a small eval harness (50 queries) to catch regressions pre-release.

Marta (PM): Great. I'll update roadmap doc and spin up a short exec brief. Lia — can you confirm pilot customers by EOD? @deploy-bot can we schedule a deploy freeze window for the canary: `/rollout --canary=0.05` Friday 09:00-12:00 PST?

deploy-bot: Scheduling: noted. Deploy freeze set for 2024-05-03 09:00-12:00 PST. Reminder: release manager must unlock.

Lia (CS): Confirming two pilots: AcmeSearch and MedNote. Both require Dedicated for embeddings. I'll sync contracts :thumbsup:

Ajay (Eng): Putting task list in product board. Will post perf delta numbers when ready.
